Enum Class Symbol

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Symbol>
net.tessel.fx.icons.Symbol
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Symbol>, Constable
public enum Symbol extends Enum<Symbol>
The glyph catalog of Tessel (the same names as Tessel4J's Symbol and Tessel.js). Use with Icon. Every glyph is vector-drawn, so they look the same on Windows, macOS and Linux and need no icon font.
